The plate looks about 26 cm across, which is roughly 355 px in the image, so about 13.7 px per cm.

Each sausage is about 135 px long, or roughly 10 cm. Their widths are about 55 px (4 cm) and 60 px (4.4 cm).

I estimated each sausage as a cylinder. For the left one, π × 2² × 10 ≈ 125 cm³, which comes to about 110 g after allowing for the rounded ends. The right one is slightly larger, so I put it at about 125 g.
